meta.title: FLUX 3 vs Grok Imagine Video 1.5: Scores & Specs
meta.description: Compare FLUX 3 and Grok Imagine Video 1.5 for quality, control, duration, audio and pricing.

quickVerdict.title: Quick verdict
quickVerdict.body: Choose FLUX 3 for final visual quality, multishot and deeper production control. Choose Grok 1.5 for simpler generation and broader fixed aspect ratios. Standard FLUX 3 and Draft also support 1–10 timed keyframes. FAST Edit belongs only to standard FLUX 3 at 720p and inherits source timing, framing and audio. Enhance needs your own eligible native Draft and a qualified paired cache; a public MP4 or Draft Extend result cannot supply it. Enhance has a separate quote and does not transfer to Max.
